name: aspect-ratio
description: A source-owned CSS aspect-ratio wrapper for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: A pure re-export of the owned AspectRatio primitive: a CSS padding-bottom ratio wrapper with no visual styling to compose, matching upstream's own unstyled behavior.
documentation.accessibility: No ARIA role applies -- a layout container is not itself a widget (`packages/adico-primitives/src/aspect_ratio.rs`). Accessibility of the ratio-constrained content (e.g. an ``'s `alt` text) remains the caller's responsibility.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; purely layout.
